resources.string: Lets Saira finish what you ask her to do on your phone: press Send or Call in WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, imo, Viber or your SMS app, and lock the screen. Saira only acts for a few seconds right after you confirm a command, and never reads or saves anything else on your screen.
